actual_functions: clinical care and continuity within treating services
patient accommodation assessment through treating department/inpatient unit and/or Patient Relations
local records/privacy/safety functions where separately assigned
excluded_functions: automatic entitlement to every requested mechanism
levels.claimed_undertaking: Patient requests traceable assignment, accessible current care and independent institutional routing.
levels.contrary_or_limit: Published routes do not establish which office received, accepted or completed any patient-specific task.
levels.repair: Identify accepted task owner, limit, next step and handoff; keep current care parallel to allegation review.
levels.forum: Treating service; Patient Relations/accessibility and other UCSF functions actually assigned by policy.
levels.notice_application: EHR or portal presence alone does not prove review, understanding or agreement absent evidence/rule.

actual_functions: Health Services Committee strategic oversight of UC Health
excluded_functions: automatic control of an individual clinical decision
automatic UC-wide liability from campus affiliation
levels.claimed_undertaking: System/campus governance should make actual delegation and escalation visible where invoked.
levels.contrary_or_limit: No source in this packet establishes patient-specific Regents, UCOP, Health Services Committee or Chancellor review.
internal_cost_categories: central resource escalation where policy applies
potentially_shifted_costs: coordination imposed on campus/patient if actual system boundary is unclear
levels.repair: Escalate only when actual delegated authority or policy requires it; record acceptance rather than copying higher offices reflexively.
levels.forum: Regents/President/Chancellor/system functions only within actual delegated authority.
unresolved: whether any campus resource escalation was invoked
levels.notice_application: A copy to a UC-level body does not establish review or system responsibility without routing/authority evidence.

actual_functions: license and regulate physicians within jurisdiction
discipline/cite/fine or refer formal disciplinary matters through the statutory process
levels.claimed_undertaking: A regulator can examine physician conduct without becoming the treating service.
levels.contrary_or_limit: This matrix does not establish the status, merits, timeliness or outcome of any complaint.
internal_cost_categories: public investigative/administrative work when a complaint is actually accepted
potentially_shifted_costs: duplicate explanation if institutional records/routing are incomplete
levels.repair: Use the Board for issues within its statutory physician-regulation mandate while continuing clinical-access work elsewhere.
levels.forum: Medical Board; Attorney General/administrative hearing if the Board's process reaches formal discipline.
levels.notice_application: Complaint filing/receipt is not a finding; investigation referral is not discipline; discipline requires its own process.

actual_functions: CRD enforcement of covered civil-rights laws including state-funded-program discrimination
CRD investigation/resolution/litigation where jurisdiction and evidence support it
CDPH/CHCQ facility licensing/certification oversight and facility complaints
other courts/law-enforcement/prosecutorial functions only under their own authority
excluded_functions: automatic substitution for physician licensing, clinical care or civil/criminal courts
levels.claimed_undertaking: State architecture should be mapped by actual jurisdiction, not collapsed into one generic 'state' actor.
levels.contrary_or_limit: A sequence of legitimate jurisdictional limits can create transaction cost without itself establishing illegality.
potentially_shifted_costs: delay and duplicated evidence packaging across noninterchangeable forums
levels.repair: Identify the correct forum once per proposition, preserve routing/notice state, and avoid making the patient re-prove jurisdiction at every handoff.
levels.forum: CRD or CDPH where their jurisdiction applies; other state legal forums remain #184 work.
levels.notice_application: Acceptance for investigation is not a merits finding, and one agency's receipt is not presumed notice to another.
